title: Heartbeat every 10 minutes while a role runs (docs/design.md:353, proposed)

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: ork records a role's ledger step once, at start (internal/engine/round.go:351-363), and sends no heartbeat while the role runs. slicer treats a step as stale after 30 minutes (../slicer/src/slicer/ai.py:385-386). A heartbeat is `slicer relay-run step RUN --step N --phase start` with no --task (../slicer/docs/commands.md:71). design.md:353 marks the 10 minute interval *proposed*.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/engine/round.go:351-371` (stepStart and stepEnd: start a ticker after stepStart, stop it in stepEnd).
- `internal/slicercli/write.go:130-152` (RelayStep; the heartbeat passes no task).
- `internal/slicercli/types.go:122` (StepSpec).
- `internal/clitest/clitest.go` (fake slicer records the calls).
- `internal/engine/*_test.go` (new heartbeat tests; the interval is a field so tests can shorten it).
- `docs/design.md:353` (remove *proposed* once decided).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestHeartbeatSendsStepStartWithoutTask: a round longer than the interval sends `--step N --phase start`, no task.
- TestHeartbeatStopsAtStepEnd: no call after stepEnd.
- TestShortRoundSendsNoHeartbeat.
- TestFailedHeartbeatDoesNotStopRole: recording is advisory (internal/engine/states.go:33).
- TestHeartbeatIntervalIsTenMinutes: the value is under the 30-minute stale limit.
